_comment: Exp 41 — Bounded Mathematics module: bench/dm/_convergence.py (the ConvergenceDetector — three-metric conservative convergence detection with severity veto, kappa_set/kappa_rate/kappa_adopt combined via min, tau_kappa separate from gamma). Per operational tracker target-article matrix: 'Mathematics calibration target'. ARTEFACT IS SUBSTANTIAL: 437 lines, ~17K bytes — NOT a small slice. This is the first experiment under the corrected methodology (founder-directed 2026-05-22): (1) STATIC TEST ARTICLE — apply_fixes_back_enabled is false, the panel reviews the same frozen file every round, fixes are folded between experiments not during them; (2) COMPELLED CONVERGENCE — §10 of cdsfl_core_formal.md now formalises the per-round sufficiency assessment (terminate when all hard assumptions tested+sound, no residual finding meets the real-world-consequence threshold, no novel findings this round; declarations are evidenced and refutable); (3) PRIMARY/SECONDARY ROUTE FALLBACK — every model has a secondary route configured in load_default_config, the runner's _dispatch_single_model retries in-round on empty/raise (no model misses a round); (4) RECONSTRUCTION BYPASSES REMOVED — reasoning-trace substitution and synthesis chunk-analyses reconstruction were deleted (commit 86470a5), empty content propagates honestly to ITC and the FailureHandler; (5) HARDENED GATE — F4 settled-registry + F6 consequence-based critical definition + conjunction + dual-series + sparsity fallback, frozen pre-registered defaults identical to Exp 40 (theta=0.30, W=3, sustain=2, min_cum=8, loo=0.05). 15 Exp 40 fixes harvested into live bench/dm/_feedback.py before this run (full-suite-gated). Exp 41 tests whether the corrected methodology produces clean convergence on a substantial bounded-mathematics artefact — a stronger methodology test than re-running the open-ended Exp 40 parser slice.

_convergence_criteria.description: HARDENED gate (hardened_gate_enabled=true). Converged iff, on the SETTLED post-reconciliation registry critical/structural series: (A) gamma_critical >= 0.30 AND (B) sustained over 2 consecutive settled recomputes AND leave-one-round-out robust within 0.05, AND (C) 3 consecutive settled rounds with zero novel critical findings. Sparsity fallback: if cumulative critical < 8 closure rests on (C) alone, gamma_critical reported-not-gated. All-severity gamma is logged as a diagnostic only and NEVER gates. Conjunction, not the legacy OR. NEW (2026-05-22): models now also operate under §10 compelled-convergence — they are expected to declare convergence with reasoning when material defects are exhausted, rather than continuing to enumerate immaterial edge cases. Their declarations are themselves falsifiable evidence; they do not replace the hardened gate but reduce instructional pressure to over-produce findings.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: (gamma_crit>=0.30 sustained+loo-robust AND 3r zero-novel-critical) OR (sparsity fallback: cum_crit<8 AND 3r zero-novel-critical).
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds.

_payload_note: Target ~17K chars (the bounded ConvergenceDetector module, 437 lines). Likely triggers decomposed dispatch for some models on large rounds; the (now-bypass-free) decomposed path will engage; if it returns empty, the in-round secondary route fallback engages; if both empty, the persistent_empty_flags HIL accumulator records it (no model excluded — no benching).
_methodology_changes_vs_exp40: (1) STATIC TARGET: apply_fixes_back_enabled=false — the panel reviews the same frozen bench/dm/_convergence.py every round. Fixes are folded post-experiment, not mid-experiment. This eliminates the moving-target problem observed in Exp 40 (cumulative critical climbed A→18, C→15). (2) Compelled convergence via §10 of cdsfl_core_formal.md — system prompt now explicitly frames the per-round task as a sufficiency assessment, not unbounded problem-finding. (3) Secondary route fallback architecture (commit e0272c6) — every model has a secondary; no model misses a round. (4) Reconstruction bypasses removed (commit 86470a5) — empties propagate honestly to ITC + FailureHandler.
